svg.aria-label: The studio at 3am — a small isometric room where websites get made
svg.title: The studio at 3am
svg.desc: A cozy isometric developer studio at night. Purple lamp glowing by a window, a desk with a monitor displaying contribution activity, a coffee cup with rising steam, a small plant, a cassette tape labeled 'NOW BUILDING', and a framed butterfly on the wall. The whole scene is rendered in near-black with purple #A456B9 and lavender #ECDBFA accents.
